items.title: Joe LaBarbera interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 15, 2021
items.q: Interviewer mentions Steve Gadd auditioned for the Mickey Mouse Club; Interviewee confirms 'That’s right' and 'That is true.'

ctx.x: That’s true, Monk, sorry I didn’t mean to interrupt you. It also paid the most dividend when I was starting to improvise with other musicians and I had that melodic sense kind of ingrained into my head about what music is supposed to sound like. You know I could almost visualize the perspective of the saxophone player as that person would relate to the drummer. You know?
Um hum. I’ve picked up, our viewers should know that I have also met with your two brothers so a few little anecdotes: I understand that the band and Steve Gadd auditioned for the Mickey Mouse Club.
